manifest.name: dsh-cc-auto-memory
manifest.author: jay (jayhchen)
manifest.description: Claude Code-compatible auto memory for DeepSeek Harness: host-injected index recall, plain-file tools, and a read-only viewer page in Settings.

bundle.text:
# dsh-cc-auto-memory bundle patch.
#
# Inserts the Host plugin row. The browser half is declared by `dsh.client`
# in package.json. Every config value below can be overridden by the user's
# own patch layer without editing this file.
- insert:
    - id: auto-memory
      name: dsh-cc-auto-memory
      config:
        # Storage mode: 'dsh' keeps memory under $DSH_HOME/projects/<slug>/memory,
        # 'claude' shares ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory with Claude Code.
        mode: dsh
        # Base directory of the Claude Code config when mode is 'claude'.
        # Empty means: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set, otherwise ~/.claude.
        claudeConfigDir: ''
        # Read limits for the MEMORY.md index, mirroring Claude Code defaults.
        maxIndexLines: 200
        maxIndexBytes: 25600

readme.text: **Claude Code's auto memory, packaged as a lightweight plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): persistent, file-based memory.** [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cc-auto-memory) [](./LICENSE) [](./README.md) [](./README.zh-CN.md)

At the start of each session, memory-usage instructions and the `MEMORY.md` index are injected automatically; the model manages memory files with the plain `read` / `write` / `edit` tools — no dedicated memory tools are registered. The on-disk format is identical to Claude Code's, so memories are directly interoperable between the two (`claude` mode even shares the exact same directory).

Web (CLI):

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cc-auto-memory
```

Desktop: open the in-app **Plugins** page and search for `dsh-cc-auto-memory`.

A faithful port of [Claude Code's native auto memory](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory) — see the official docs for the original mechanism. Per session it works like this:

```
session start
    │
    ▼
host injects into the system prompt:

- Subagent sessions get no main-session memory injected (same as Claude Code).
- Project resolution: git repository root (cwd when outside a repo), `/` → `-` in the slug; one shared memory per repository.

Settings → Auto Memory (read-only viewing; editing/creating/deleting is left to the agent's file tools during a session):

- **Storage mode**: two mode cards (dsh standalone directory / claude reuse) plus an "Apply switch" button — switching only takes effect for new sessions:
  - `dsh` (default): `$DSH_HOME/projects/<slug>/memory/`
  - `claude`: `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/` (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` respected) — shares the same memory with Claude Code, interoperable both ways

> In claude mode, the model's write/edit calls into `~/.claude/` fall outside the session workspace and trigger approvals per the session sandbox policy — this is expected.
- **Project list filtered by the active mode**: dsh mode shows only projects under `$DSH_HOME`; claude mode shows only projects under `~/.claude`
- **Memory table**: **click any row to open a floating card** showing the raw file content (plain text, Markdown not rendered); Esc or clicking the overlay closes it

`cordis.patch.yml` can be overridden at the user layer:

| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `dsh` | Storage mode `dsh` / `claude` |
| `claudeConfigDir` | `''` | Claude Code config root for claude mode; empty = `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `~/.claude` |
| `maxIndexLines` | `200` | Line limit when reading `MEMORY.md` |
| `maxIndexBytes` | `25600` | Byte limit when reading `MEMORY.md` |

**把 Claude Code 的 auto memory 机制原样带到 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的轻量级记忆插件：纯文件的持久化记忆。** [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cc-auto-memory) [](./LICENSE) [](./README.md) [](./README.zh-CN.md) 每个会话开始时会自动注入使用说明和 `MEMORY.md` 索引，模型直接用普通的 `read` / `write` / `edit` 文件工具管理记忆文件，不注册任何专用 memory 工具。落盘格式与 Claude Code 完全一致，两边记忆可直接互通（`claude` 模式甚至直接共享同一个记忆目录）。

Web 端（命令行）：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cc-auto-memory
```

桌面版：打开应用内 **Plugins（插件）** 页，搜索 `dsh-cc-auto-memory` 安装。

机制上是对 [Claude Code 原生 auto memory](https://code.claude.com/docs/zh-CN/memory) 的忠实移植，原始机制可参考官方文档。每个会话的运作流程：

```
session start
    │
    ▼
host injects into the system prompt:

- 子代理（subagent）会话不注入主会话记忆（与 Claude Code 一致）。
- 项目定位：git 仓库根目录（仓库外用 cwd），路径中 `/` 替换为 `-` 作为 slug，同一仓库共享一份记忆。

Settings → Auto Memory（只读查看，编辑/新建/删除交给会话中的 Agent 用文件工具完成）：

- **存储模式**：两张模式卡片（dsh 独立目录 / claude 复用）＋「应用切换」按钮，切换只对新会话生效：
  - `dsh`（默认）：`$DSH_HOME/projects/<slug>/memory/`
  - `claude`：`~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/`（尊重 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`），与 Claude Code 共享同一份记忆，双向互通

> claude 模式下，模型通过 write/edit 写 `~/.claude/` 位于会话工作区之外，会按会话沙箱策略触发审批，属预期行为。
- **项目列表按当前模式过滤**：dsh 模式只显示 `$DSH_HOME` 下的项目，claude 模式只显示 `~/.claude` 下的项目
- **记忆表格**：**点击任意行弹出悬浮卡片**展示文件原文（纯文本，不渲染 Markdown），Esc 或点击遮罩关闭

`cordis.patch.yml` 用户层可覆盖：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `dsh` | 存储模式 `dsh` / `claude` |
| `claudeConfigDir` | `''` | claude 模式的 CC 配置根；空 = `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 或 `~/.claude` |
| `maxIndexLines` | `200` | MEMORY.md 读取行数上限 |
| `maxIndexBytes` | `25600` | MEMORY.md 读取字节上限 |
